metadata.description: Illustrative planning defaults for an AI-led social video project. This is not a JSON Schema, native Kdenlive project, or executable render recipe.
metadata.execution_engine: Choose and verify per project: Kdenlive/MLT and/or FFmpeg
metadata.source_of_truth: production.json plus the approved timeline/edit decision files
metadata.warning: Every setting must be checked against the user's brief, source media, tool capabilities, current delivery requirements, licensing and approval gates. Unimplemented values are advisory only.

vertical_fhd_example.note: Example only; verify source and destination requirements.

horizontal_fhd_example.note: Example only; verify source and destination requirements.

deliverables.profile_selection: Ask or infer from explicit destination; don't use a global preset blindly.

editorial_guidance.first_principle: Story and viewer comprehension before effects.
editorial_guidance.timing_units: Preserve rational frame-rate/timebase and source in/out; avoid rounding cuts to whole seconds.
editorial_guidance.pacing: Motivate shot duration by performance, information, tone and comprehension rather than hard universal thresholds.
editorial_guidance.transitions: Use a cut by default; add transitions only when they support the story or communicate a meaningful change.

graphics_and_captions.safe_placement: Check actual target UI/device overlays; no universal safe-area percentage.
graphics_and_captions.fonts_and_assets: Check local availability, license and destination rendering before use.

audio_and_color.priority: Dialogue intelligibility when speech carries the message.
audio_and_color.audio: Measure loudness/true peak only against a selected standard; preserve source and license notes.
audio_and_color.color: Probe source tags, correct exposure/white balance and shot match before any creative look.
audio_and_color.effects: No film grain, chromatic aberration, aggressive EQ, music ducking or SFX by default.

export_and_qc.export_policy: Select from actual platform specs, quality/file-size constraints and installed encoders.
